_note: Fixed assistant replies (SPEC §5). No generated text. HI/MR listed in docs/i18n_review_p8.md.
disclaimer: Answers come from a fixed, pre-written library — VITALNEX does not generate medical advice. It does not diagnose and does not recommend medicines. In an emergency call 108 / 112.
emergency: This may be a medical emergency. Call 108 (ambulance) or 112 now, or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not wait to see if it passes.
medication_refusal: I can't advise on medicines or doses. Please ask your doctor or pharmacist — they know your health history. If you feel very unwell, call 108 / 112.
greeting: Hello! I am the VITALNEX assistant. I can explain your latest screening result, suggest what you could change, answer common questions about diabetes, heart disease and stroke, and help you find a doctor or book an appointment.
out_of_scope: Sorry, I can only help with VITALNEX screening, diabetes, heart disease, stroke, doctors and appointments, and your data. Try one of the suggestions below.
no_faq_answer: I don't have a reliable answer to that in my pre-written library. Please ask a doctor, or try one of the suggestions below.
unavailable: The assistant's language model is not available right now, so I can only help with emergencies and navigation. If you feel unwell, call 108 / 112.
no_assessment: I could not find a saved screening for you. Run a screening first (and allow 'store history' if you want me to explain it later).
explain_abstained: {disease}: not confident — VITALNEX could not give a reliable band for your answers.
explain_footer: These bands say how similar your answers are to people who have been told they have the condition. They are not a diagnosis.
change_intro: Based on your latest screening answers, these general steps may help:
change_none: I could not find a saved screening to base suggestions on. Run a screening first.
change_footer: Open the what-if tool on your results to see how a change might move your bands. Age, sex and past diagnoses cannot be changed.
book: You can book, move or cancel a demo appointment on the Appointments page.
find_doctor: You can browse demo clinicians by speciality, language and area in Care Connect.
my_data: You can see, download or delete your data and change your consent choices in Settings → My data. Chat messages are never stored.

next_step.emergency: Your last screening found warning signs: call 108 / 112 now. No scores were calculated.
next_step.correct_inputs: Some answers looked impossible, so no result was calculated. Please check your answers.
next_step.not_confident: VITALNEX is not confident for you. Please see a doctor.
next_step.discuss_next_checkup: Discuss these results at your next check-up.
